# §5→0 — The Catuṣkoṭi Crossing

## #0 — The fact being logicised

The input is the conscious circumstance: something appears, its appearing is known, and that knowing is not one further object beside the appearance. The symbols are already earned: `0` marks unobjectifiable awareness, `1` the appearing determination, `/` their mediating relation.

File 1 §5→0 in the [Binary Explication](../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-binary-explication/taylor-2026-binary-explication.md) sources the crossing of **0 IS AND/OR IS-NOT EQUAL TO 1**. This is the author's native development using the four corners; it does not claim that an external Buddhist source supplies QL's notation or positional derivation. The [?/! root](../../question-assertion.md) grounds the relation of inquiry and assertion.

## #1 — IS and IS-NOT

**IS:** the phenomenon belongs to awareness in the act in which it appears. Its givenness cannot be removed while preserving it as something presently known. Taken as exhaustive identity, this reading would dissolve the distinction through which something stands forth.

**IS-NOT:** awareness is not consumed by the particular phenomenon now appearing. The determination has a limit; its condition continues to permit further determination. Taken as exhaustive separation, this reading would sever the knowing from what is given through it.

Each corner performs necessary work. Their limits arise when either claims the whole relation for its own operation.

## #2 — BOTH

**BOTH** holds the two operations together. The phenomenon belongs to awareness and does not exhaust it. The slash marks the difference of respect: belonging is affirmed without an identity of all offices; non-exhaustion is affirmed without severance.

The result retains the two corners' achievements. Yet saying “both” is still an account. Its formulation does not place the speaker outside the relation it describes. The next operation tests that remaining claim of completeness.

## #3 — NEITHER

**NEITHER** turns the identifying apparatus upon its own condition. Identity, difference, and their held conjunction have each become available for thought. Their complete description still occurs within the circumstance it seeks to determine. No member of that predicative set can assume the office of the whole condition of predication.

File 1 places `1/0` at this constitutive limit. Ordinary arithmetic's undefined division and QL's recognition of non-enclosure retain different formal offices. [A03](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A03-Immutable-Gap-Formal-Limit.md) qualifies the philosophical movement; a general act of position-taking has not thereby become a formal system satisfying an incompleteness theorem's hypotheses.

## #4 — SILENCE

**SILENCE** names the recognition through which the four corners become one lived movement. It is not a fifth truth value appended to their list. Affirmation, denial, their co-presence, and their suspension remain available, while the person recognises the circumstance in which all four occur.

File 1 locates this recognition at #5. [∞/dx](../../infinity-dx.md) embodies its exactness: the field can be articulated locally without being enclosed by its articulation. [The six determinations](six-determinations.md) can now be read as the source's reflected ways of becoming legible within the conscious circumstance, rather than descriptions imposed from outside it.

## #5→0 — Encounter again

The return reaches the opening situation with the full crossing retained. The short chain `0/1 = 4+2 = 5→0 = 0/1` carries the definitional vantage. Its result is a changed relation to the determinations through which the person can speak, know, and answer.

This projection returns-to [A01](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A01-Subject-God-and-Faithful-Definition.md), whose performed definition preserves the fourth/fifth asymmetry, and [A18](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md). It returns-to [Movement25](../../../section-rooms/04-mathematical-substrate/movements/25-s3-p0-eight-determinations.md) for the whole sequence. The [formal-neighbour folder](../formal-neighbours/README.md) extends the separate task of comparing this crossing with explicit logical calculi.
